afterBuild.configurationEvidence: Recorded CMake cache settings and probe location; no build flags inferred from filenames.

scope: MXF and OMF/legacy replay discarded after extraction; PMR/MDB snapshots unchanged; AVB untouched.
method: Four real-file datasets, scan/evidence comparisons, then three alternating fresh-process pairs. Same Release configuration; warm filesystem cache; no overlapping build/test work. Scan timer and RAM sample precede CSV/proof work. No Windows/NEXIS throughput claim.

genuineLegacyCopies.scope: 80 genuine Avid supporting OMF files plus two MediaComposer WAV/AIFF files; copied media only, no databases

limitations: MacOS warm-cache scanner-process samples, not whole-GUI or Windows/NEXIS measurements.
